XuYing.title: Phantom
XuYing.description: Retained in your hand at the end of the turn. Cannot be played manually.

XianGu.title: Immortal Gu
XianGu.description: A rank 6 or higher Gu. Across the run, all players may permanently own only one Immortal Gu with the same card identity. This rule is independent of [gold]Unique[/gold].

CuiDong.title: Activation
CuiDong.description: A Gu card requires an available Activation card in hand. Confirming the Gu automatically pays for and plays one Activation.

HuiFu.title: Recovery
HuiFu.description: After all activations are spent, the Gu enters recovery and returns to the Gu pile after the listed number of turns.

HeLian.title: Fusion
HeLian.description: Consumes the specified Gu materials to refine a new Gu. Its rank follows the recipe and it is normally excluded from rewards.

XueYuan.title: Blood Essence
XueYuan.description: A Blood Path combat resource capped at 12 and cleared after combat.

XueJi.title: Blood Parasite
XueJi.description: A parasite attached to a normal Attack, Skill, or Power. It follows its host through hand, draw, and discard piles.

XueQi.title: Blood Qi
XueQi.description: Adapts to the host: damage and Bleed, Block and Blood Essence, or direct Blood Essence. Higher ranks trigger multiple times.

YueXiang.title: Moon Phase
YueXiang.description: Blood Moon advances Crescent → Waxing → Full. Each complete host resolution advances one phase.

XueTai.title: Blood Fetus
XueTai.description: A compound parasite. Each trigger adapts to the host and gains Fetal Movement; it hatches at 3.

TaiDong.title: Fetal Movement
TaiDong.description: Blood Fetus maturity. It hatches at 3; devouring another parasite can inherit 1–2 progress.

PoTai.title: Rupture
PoTai.description: If an immature parasitized host enters Exhaust, remove the parasite and gain 1 Blood Essence without resolving remaining effects.

FuHua.title: Hatch
FuHua.description: The final resolution after a parasite completes its last trigger, after which it is removed.

TunJi.title: Devour Parasite
TunJi.description: Blood Fetus replaces Blood Qi or a non-Full Moon parasite and inherits 1–2 Fetal Movement.

ZongEDu.title: Shared Pool
ZongEDu.description: AoE damage, Bleed, or Blood Marks are shared totals divided among living enemies, not copied per enemy.

YiHai.title: Remains
YiHai.description: A 0-cost Status created by parasitic kills. It can grant Blood Essence or be consumed by Blood Skull and Blood Bat effects.

XueLu.title: Blood Skull
XueLu.description: Up to 3. Strengthens parasites, defenses, and Blood Bats; absorbing Remains at cap heals instead.

LiuXue.title: Bleed
LiuXue.description: At the end of the target turn, remove 1, deal 3 damage, and grant the applier 1 Blood Essence.

XueYin.title: Blood Mark
XueYin.description: After Blood Path attack damage from the applier, consume 1 and lose 3 HP. A card play refunds at most 1 Blood Essence globally.

CanYue.title: Crescent
CanYue.description: Moon Phase stage 1. Resolve the lower shared damage and Bleed pool, then advance to Waxing.

YingYue.title: Waxing
YingYue.description: Moon Phase stage 2. Resolve the middle shared pool and possible Blood Marks, then advance to Full.

ManYue.title: Full Moon
ManYue.description: Final Moon Phase. Resolve the largest shared pool and hatch; rank 6+ refunds Blood Essence and rank 9 also draws.

XianYuan.title: Immortal Essence
XianYuan.description: An additional activation resource for Rank 6 or higher Immortal Gu. A depleted essence card is Exhausted after the entire Gu play sequence finishes.

ZheGuang.title: Refraction
ZheGuang.description: Alternating between different Light-path Attack, Skill, or Power types grants Radiance, up to a per-turn limit.

ZhaoPo.title: Exposure
ZhaoPo.description: The next hit from an Attack card deals bonus damage per stack and removes 1 stack. Multi-hit attacks read it one hit at a time.

JuGuang.title: Focus Light
JuGuang.description: Increases the first damage hit of the next Light-path Attack. Fixed bonus damage is not repeated by multi-hit attacks.

DingGuang.title: Fixed Light
DingGuang.description: Increases the first hit of the next Attack that strikes a target already carrying Exposure, then clears after the first Attack damage resolves.

LiuGuang.title: Stored Light
LiuGuang.description: At end of turn, gain Radiance if enough Block remains. Each application resolves once.

PoJing.title: Shattered Mirror
PoJing.description: Gain Radiance the first time Block is completely broken during the current defense window. Each application triggers once.

YiChu.title: Overflow
YiChu.description: When a resource gain exceeds its cap, the amount that could not be gained is converted into another benefit as stated by the card.

ZhuiJi.title: Pursuit
ZhuiJi.description: If the target dies, unresolved remaining hits move to another living enemy.

XueHe.title: Blood River
XueHe.description: Automatically chooses a supply mode or high-defense mode based on current Blood Essence. High-defense mode spends Blood Essence and carries part of its Block into next turn.

YaoHua1.title: Illumination 1
YaoHua1.description: When you have at least 1 Radiance, automatically spend 1 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua2.title: Illumination 2
YaoHua2.description: When you have at least 2 Radiance, automatically spend 2 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua3.title: Illumination 3
YaoHua3.description: When you have at least 3 Radiance, automatically spend 3 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua4.title: Illumination 4
YaoHua4.description: When you have at least 4 Radiance, automatically spend 4 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua5.title: Illumination 5
YaoHua5.description: When you have at least 5 Radiance, automatically spend 5 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua6.title: Illumination 6
YaoHua6.description: When you have at least 6 Radiance, automatically spend 6 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua7.title: Illumination 7
YaoHua7.description: When you have at least 7 Radiance, automatically spend 7 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua8.title: Illumination 8
YaoHua8.description: When you have at least 8 Radiance, automatically spend 8 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua9.title: Illumination 9
YaoHua9.description: When you have at least 9 Radiance, automatically spend 9 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_SHI_GU.description: Gain {Dexterity:diff()} temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. {BlockRetentionTurns:cond:>0?For the next {BlockRetentionTurns} turn(s), your Block is not removed at the start of your turn.|}
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_FEI_XIONG_XU_YING.descr: Whenever you play an Attack, have a {ChancePercent}% chance to deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. NL Strength affects this damage {StrengthMultiplier} times.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_QING_TI_XIAN_YUAN.descr: Retain as immortal essence. Provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_HONG_ZAO_XIAN_YUAN.desc: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two Green Grape essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_LI_XIAN_YUAN.descri: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two Red Date essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_HUANG_XING_XIAN_YUAN.de: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two White Litchi essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.

restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.name: Gu Refinement
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.descriptio: By default, raise 1 eligible Gu Worm by one rank. After your deck contains a rank-6 Gu Worm, you may select up to 2. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.selectionP: Choose Gu Worms to raise by one rank. After reaching rank 6, you may select up to 2.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.name: Gu Fusion
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.description: Choose one or more Gu cards and click Confirm manually. The selection limit is determined by currently craftable recipes. Materials are consumed only when both their types and quantities match a recipe. A failed attempt does not consume the use. Fusion can succeed once per rest site.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.selectionProm: Choose fusion materials, then click Confirm. The required count depends on the recipe.

combatInterfaceLocalizationFallbacks.text: Gu Storage Pile

Stores Gu Worms with activations remaining. Depleted Gu enter the Recovery Pile and use an independent recovery time based on type and rank; some higher-rank Gu create normal derivative cards during recovery. Left-click to inspect.
There are no Gu Worms available in the Gu Storage Pile.
Choose the next Gu Worm in recipe order. {SelectedCount} selected; after choosing at least one, confirm or go back to finish.
Gu Recovery Pile

Stores depleted Gu Worms. Each Gu Worm recovers independently according to its type and rank; some rank-3 or higher Gu create normal derivative cards when entering or progressing through recovery. Left-click to inspect; right-click and spend 1 Energy to deduce a Killer Move. On success, also pay twice the average effective Primeval Essence cost of all materials, rounded up. Materials are Exhausted, and the Killer Move enters your hand without counting as a Gu Worm.
The Gu Recovery Pile is empty.
Brilliance
A character resource capped at 9. Brilliance does not disappear at end of turn; Light Path cards can gain or spend it.
Illumination Break
The next time a single hit from an Attack card deals damage, take 3 additional damage and remove 1 Illumination Break. Multi-hit attacks can consume multiple stacks.
Blood Essence
A personal character resource capped at 12. Only Blood Path Gu cards and their exclusive debuffs can gain or spend Blood Essence.
Blood Mark

After taking unblocked damage from the applier’s Blood Path Gu Attack, remove 1 Blood Mark and lose 3 additional HP. Across the battlefield, each CardPlay grants at most 1 Blood Essence; Replay starts a new CardPlay.
Bleed
At the end of the owner’s turn, remove 1 Bleed, grant the applier 1 Blood Essence, and deal 3 damage to the owner.
Blood Qi Recovery
At the start of your next turn, heal {Amount} HP, then remove this effect.
Primeval Essence
Primeval essence stored in a Gu Master's aperture. Begin combat with 5; from turn 2 onward, restore 2 at the start of each turn. Maximum essence increases with aperture rank, up to 25.
Blood Skull
Up to 3 stacks. Each strengthens Blood Path parasites, defenses, and Blade-Wing Blood Bat multi-hit attacks, but does not increase resource generation.
Blood Parasite
{Amount} card(s) carry an unresolved Blood Path parasite. The parasite triggers after the host’s final play and is then removed.
Blood River After-Armor
At the start of your next turn, gain {Amount} Block, then remove this effect.

OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.descriptio: Select 0 to 2 eligible Gu Worms and raise each by one rank. Click Confirm after making your selection. Confirming with 0 selected cancels the action. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.selectionP: Select 0 to 2 Gu Worms to raise by one rank, then click Confirm.
